purpose.zh: 分腿坐、双脚离地，练腿收回和伸直的控制
purpose.en: Sit in a straddle with your feet up and control your legs as they bend and straighten.

text.zh: 双脚不落地，腿伸直再往两边收回
text.en: Keep your feet up, straighten your legs, then bend your knees back out to the sides

text.zh: 双手撑在身体前面，胸口朝前。
text.en: Put your hands on the floor in front of you and keep your chest facing forward.
Do not lean back; move slowly.

cautions.zh: 髋或腰疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hips or lower back hurt, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 改名：「屈伸」是术语 → 分腿坐收腿伸腿 / Seated Straddle Tuck and Extend
动画从收腿开始：伸直 0.8 s / 停 0.2 s / 收回 0.8 s / 停 0.2 s；口令顺序改成 伸直→收回（原 start「收腿」peak「伸直」顺序反了）
flags: 改名：坐姿分腿屈伸 → 分腿坐收腿伸腿（EN Seated Straddle Extension → Seated Straddle Tuck and Extend）
